title: A whole-site build that stops before any check is sent to check, a crop rounded to whole pixels is not refused, a turn reopened by a steer is not failed in the seconds it was closed, and a build skips the single-change visual check
steps: S1: agentImageRecipe with the round-18 band rows (942x881 into 2000/800, 775x590 into 1800/900) and a bad strategy, a wrong output shape, an 8000 px output.
S2: checkAgainStep with no check in the log, one failed check, a passed one, five failed, a spent budget.
S3: a client-send turn closed completed with no passing check, read at once and then three minutes later.
S4: the shipped site-tools bundle: a conversation that answered tracy_demo stops its turn.
expect: S1: outputs 942x377 and 775x388; each bad recipe names its own reason.
S2: no check steers 'No check has run … 5 checks remain'; one failed steers '4 of 5 checks remain'; the rest steer nothing.
S3: queued at once; failed AGENT_DEMO_ENDED_UNCHECKED three minutes later.
S4: no visual comparison is asked; the only steer is tracy-site-tools:check-again.

tests: a crop brought down to whole pixels keeps its shape; what is still wrong is refused with its own why
a client-send turn that ends completed without a passing check fails the action instead of filling forever
checkAgainStep: a build ending before any check, or on a failed check with checks left, is steered on; a pass or a spent budget is not
🔒 a build is judged by its own checks: no comparison, and the only steer is to check
